subject: french

moments.title: Algerian War
moments.body: The war kills hundreds of thousands and ends in Algerian independence.

moments.title: Fifth Republic established
moments.body: De Gaulle returns to power amid Algerian crisis; a new constitution gives the presidency stronger powers.

moments.title: May 1968 protests
moments.body: Student protests and a general strike paralyse France for weeks. De Gaulle resigns the next year.
moments.takeaway: Cultural and labour unrest can topple governments.

now.title: Fifth Republic now
now.body: Macron's second term faces continuing protest cultures. The presidency remains powerful.
now.open_questions: What replaces de Gaulle's institutional settlement?

reflection: France's current institutions were shaped in a colonial emergency.
